decisions.reason: As an upgraded version of an already well-liked screen, it appears to meet aspiration levels and is inexpensive for an experienced machinery firm to carry, so there is little pressure to reallocate resources away from it.
The 2019 rollout of all AK models with Stage V technology signals continued commitment and satisfactory prospects, reducing problemistic search and supporting retention of the line.

The product stayed visible and gained its own page after launch, which suggests acceptable early results, but the weaker performance evidence than for A, B, and F leaves a somewhat higher chance of discontinuation if aspirations are missed.

Management would likely view the CERON line as exceeding aspirations because it was presented as setting standards and showed concrete deployment, so a resource-rich incumbent would be very likely to keep it on the market.
